busan-1-day-itinerary-long.title: Things to Do in Busan in One Day: Temple, Beach and Spa
busan-1-day-itinerary-long.summary: Things to do in Busan in one day: a sea-side temple, Haeundae Beach and a Korean spa, in an easy east coast route with maps and tips.

jeju-3-day-itinerary-long.title: Things to Do in Jeju Island: Easy 3-Day Itinerary
jeju-3-day-itinerary-long.summary: Things to do in Jeju Island over three easy days: the west coast, Udo island and Hallasan, with maps, bus tips and where to stay.
